# تَعَايَيْتَ (taʕāyayta) /ta.ʕaː.jaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
# تَعَايَيْتِ (taʕāyayti) /ta.ʕaː.jaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
